name: Five-colour sticky rice
summary: Coloured sticky rice, the five-colour plate, also called colourful five-grain sticky rice.
origin: Moc Chau. Bao Son La, 17 February 2023, lists it with Thai and Muong dishes. The national authority’s attractions feature lists it with trout and dairy foods. Vietnam Tourism’s summer note uses the English name.
howToEat: Eat it as a coloured plate. Bao Son La also writes xôi lá màu in a seasonal line and does not say that name is a different dish, so both names stay on this plate.
The plants that colour it are Check on arrival. The price is Check on arrival.
where: The plateau table. A street was not printed. Check on arrival. A visitor quoted by Bao Son La names it among the plates she orders in Moc Chau.
